podcast.body: "Stars" was the first single from Hum's 1995 album, *You'd Prefer an Astronaut*. It became a big alt-rock radio hit, generating significant exposure and contributing to the album selling close to half a million records. Despite its success, subsequent singles from the album did not perform well, and the band was later dropped by RCA. "The first single was called Stars. Big, alt-rock radio hit. Lots of exposure, close to half a million records sold."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Great Alt-Rock One-Hit Wonders of the 90s: Part 2
